_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 81: 1-2 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says to harness it and not embrace it, turns to the Ark of the Covenant and says he told them a discovery would be made in the days ahead, that he told them back in January he saw them, that an earthquake and earthquakes would start to take place and a shaking would unveil something to do with the Ark of the Covenant, and that this will bring many Muslims to Jesus.
mentions.quote: a shaking will uh uh uh will unveil something to do with the ark
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake exposing the Ark, followed by mass Muslim conversions.
mentions.falsify_miss: No find. The origin date has moved: on 9 July he dated this word to February, here to January. Both are recorded and neither is withdrawn.

mentions.claim_text: He says that by fall of 2027 he saw the plague released on Europe with rats, that he said they will release this in Europe first and it will be of rats in 2027, that November and December is when he saw them starting to really escalate it in 2027, that he remembers seeing the year and the calendar flash before him and saw that 350 million people will die, and that he then saw it going into 2028 and 2029 as a shaking.
mentions.quote: By fall of 2027, I saw the plague being released on Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A rodent-borne epidemic beginning in Europe in late 2027 with a death toll approaching 350 million.
mentions.falsify_miss: No epidemic in that window. This is the most specific form of the plague claim on file: a continent, a vector, a season, a two-month escalation and a number. The 350 million figure is roughly one in twenty-three people alive, which is the scale that makes it scoreable rather than vague.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is no separation and no replacement theology and all these people are wrong, that the Lord said to look at Israel because the fruit is ripe and the figs are ripe, that great persecution is coming, and that he is bringing them home.
mentions.quote: The figs are ripe. Great persecution
mentions.falsify_match: Persecution of Jewish people followed by large-scale return to Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No date, no threshold, and the ripe figs image is the standard marker used across this corpus for whatever season is being discussed.

mentions.claim_text: He tells new believers to read from Genesis to Revelation because it will change them, to get plugged into a church, to tell the pastor they got born again watching some guy on YouTube and ask to be water baptized, to attend on Sundays and Wednesdays and small groups, and to find new friends because they may not be able to keep the old ones.
mentions.quote: I got born again watching some guy on YouTube
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: follow-up instruction with nothing forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by thanking people for joining at a different hour, says he usually comes on at night but felt in his heart to do it early today, that they will pray and go over things in the news that are important to pray over, and that they will pray over unsaved loved ones a lot today.
mentions.quote: we're going to pray over unsaved loved ones a lot today
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: an opening with nothing claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not want to be too critical but the senators and the House are a joke, that if it does not pass by the end of July as they said there is a chance the legislation will not pass until 2027 because they are trying to delay, and asks what he told them, saying he saw major banks lobbying against it with JP Morgan and others.
mentions.quote: I saw major banks lobbying against with JP Morgan and others
mentions.falsify_match: Documented lobbying by JP Morgan and other large banks against the bill.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such lobbying on the record. A named institution makes this checkable, unlike most of the economic material. Note the slip in the same breath: the bill was to pass by one vote, and now may not pass until 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says a candidate is running off against the Republican, that this is what he told them and this is the socialism coming over the internet, and that the Lord said a socialistic control and government control will be major over the internet by 2030, concerning live streams like the one he is doing now and Facebook and the other platforms.
mentions.quote: a socialistic control, government control will be major over the internets by 2030
mentions.falsify_match: State control of speech on the major platforms before 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A candidate's programme is offered as the claim already arriving, and a three and a half year window over continuously contested ground cannot come up empty.

mentions.claim_text: He discusses footage from South Dakota where the wind is so strong it is breaking the windmills and snapping them like toothpicks, allows that maybe it was a faulty one, is corrected that there are multiple, and says it is incredible.
mentions.quote: the wind is so strong in South Dakota it's breaking the windmills
mentions.falsify_match: Record wind readings in South Dakota at that date.
mentions.falsify_miss: The turbines failed for another reason. Nothing is forecast here and he raises the faulty equipment possibility himself before being talked out of it, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in February or January, corrected to January, he was praying and saw him being assassinated, that he said he will reject a two-state solution and when he does he saw Mossad take him out, that he told some elders this, and that he saw him standing out on a balcony or a porch and saw them taking him out there.
mentions.quote: I saw him and I said he will reject a two-state solution
mentions.falsify_match: The Israeli leader assassinated on a balcony after rejecting a two-state solution.
mentions.falsify_miss: No assassination. The detail is unusually specific for this corpus, a named agency, a stated trigger and a physical setting, which makes it properly scoreable. He corrects his own dating from February to January mid-sentence.

mentions.claim_text: He says she will rebrand herself over the next two years across the rest of this time frame going into 2028, that it will be like a rebranding starting right now and they are seeing it happen from last week, that the Lord spoke to them and said watch this, and asks who she is reaching out to, answering the socialists in New York.
mentions.quote: She'll rebrand herself over the next two years
mentions.falsify_match: Harris repositioning leftward toward a 2028 run.
mentions.falsify_miss: She does not run or does not shift. Rebranding has no threshold, and any politician's outreach to any faction over two years satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says this concerns what 2028 holds going into 2030 and the agenda of taking away freedoms and the First Amendment, that he told them he saw a demonic spider that looked like a black widow, that the black widow started weaving a web around the First Amendment, and that the Lord said it is trying to get to the Second Amendment but cannot yet, and he saw it poking at it.
mentions.quote: the black widow started weaving a web around the first amendment
mentions.falsify_match: Speech restrictions in place by 2030 with gun restrictions attempted and failing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Cannot get to it yet builds the delay into the claim in advance, so the Second Amendment half cannot fail inside the window.

mentions.claim_text: He says the electric bill was over seventeen thousand dollars in July and people do not realise what a little church of that size costs with eight thousand people on a weekend, that people who cannot wrap their minds around it have poverty thinking and need to change their stinking thinking, and that the Lord said to change your mindset concerning the wealth transfer.
mentions.quote: electric bill was over $17,000 in July
mentions.condition_text: if you change your mindset about wealth
mentions.falsify_match: A wealth transfer reaching those who changed their thinking.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Poverty thinking supplies the reason in advance for anyone who does not receive it. The seventeen thousand dollar bill and the eight thousand weekend attendance are stated figures and could be checked against the ministry's own filings.
